# Infrakinetic

> Infrakinetic is a unified business operating system — commercial, workforce,
> finance, governance, and reporting on one shared database — with a Migration
> Engine that discovers, maps, transforms, executes, validates, and reconciles
> data when a business moves between CRM, HRIS, ERP, or finance systems.

## What is it?

Infrakinetic is both an operating foundation for running a business (CRM/sales,
HR/payroll, finance, customer success, governance) and migration infrastructure
for moving onto or off of business systems without losing the data's meaning.

## What does the Migration Engine do?

It discovers a source system's schema (entities, fields, relationships, custom
objects), models what the data actually represents (not just field names),
maps source structures to destination equivalents with a confidence label,
stages the result in a governed airlock separated from production, executes
in dependency order, and validates and reconciles the outcome — record counts,
relationship integrity, and financial totals — before a human signs off.

## Why isn't a CSV importer enough?

Because real business systems contain relationships (a deal belongs to an
account, an employee has compensation history), custom fields and objects,
duplicate entities, and incompatible lifecycle states. A column-to-column
CSV mapping breaks down the moment any of that is present.

## What makes Infrakinetic different?

It treats migration as a systems problem — understand, map, move, prove —
rather than a file-import problem. AI proposes mappings and explanations;
deterministic validation and human approval decide what actually executes.

## Where does it work?

CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM), HRIS/payroll (BambooHR, Workday,
Rippling), finance (QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Tally), and file-based
sources (CSV, Excel, PDF, Word). The same governed pipeline underlies every
one of them.

## Why should I trust the result?

Because the migration is analyzed and risk-scored before execution, staged
in an environment separated from production, and validated with a
reconciliation report afterward — not just an "import complete" message.
